jobs.title: Customer Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Meet Instinct**


Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world\-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy\-to\-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care \& Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.


At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

**A Sneak Peek of Your Role**


This is a fully remote role.


The Customer Training Specialist is a cross\-trained product expert who delivers hands\-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round\-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.


You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post\-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.


You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

**What You'll Do ️**

**Training Delivery**

* Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go\-live readiness.
* Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post\-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
* Cross\-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
* Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

**Account Intelligence \& Preparation**

* Pre\-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
* Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
* Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow\-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

**Team Coordination \& Travel**

* Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
* Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on\-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in\-person where context and environment make it more effective.
* Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
* Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

**Who You Are ‍**


Must Haves:

* **Veterinary Practice Experience:** Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
* **Instinct Software Experience:** Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
* **Customer\-Facing Training or Education:** 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast\-paced environment.
* **CRM \& Call Intelligence Tools:** Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
* **Travel Availability:** Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

**How Instinct will Care about YOU**

* We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
* We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
* We pay our team well.
* We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
* We give our team owner\-like flexibility over work and time\-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
* We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
* We provide all\-expense\-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.


The compensation range for this role is $55,000 \- $70,000\. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

*Instinct is an equal opportunity employer committed to equality and providing a pleasant work environment free from harassment or discrimination in any form. All employees will be treated equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, ancestry, veteran, or disability status.*

*If you require accommodations throughout any part of the pre\-employment process, please contact our recruiting team at* *recruiting@instinct.vet*

At Edelman Financial Engines (EFE), our purpose is to guide people with the financial advice they need to thrive.

We believe that every dollar saved represents a lifetime of hard work and aspirations, and every dollar invested has a job to do for our clients. That's why we are committed to managing our clients' investments by truly understanding them as people first and then delivering advice, strategies and solutions to help them feel confident about the plans they are making, whether for today, tomorrow, or in the great unknown future. Our goal is to build long\-term relationships based on respect, integrity, and a belief that our responsibility is to help people make smart investments decisions in every stage of their lives.

Our culture is grounded in our CORE values: Client First, One Team, Respectful Candor, and Endless Curiosity. These values guide everything we do, for our clients and each other. We are committed to moving forward together. If you are inspired by purpose\-driven work and a collaborative, values\-led culture, we invite you to explore a career with us.

jobs.title: Client Experience Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Net at Work**

  

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid\-size businesses. Our award\-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next\-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.  

  

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry\-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

 **About this Position**


The Onboarding Specialist is a key member of the Client Experience (CX) team responsible for delivering a seamless, high\-touch onboarding experience for clients acquired through M\&A. Acting as the first point of contact post\-acquisition, this role ensures clients feel welcomed, informed, and confidently connected to Net at Work from day one.

  

The Onboarding Specialist guides clients through their first 30–60 days, facilitating introductions, coordinating onboarding activities, and ensuring all critical requirements are met before transitioning clients to their assigned Client Experience Manager (CEM). This role blends client relationship management, meeting facilitation, and operational coordination to ensure a smooth and consistent transition experience.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for newly acquired clients during onboarding, delivering a welcoming, high\-touch experience and setting clear expectations for their transition into Net at Work.
* Lead and facilitate onboarding and introduction meetings with clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring conversations are structured, productive, and build client confidence.
* Coordinate and schedule onboarding and introductory meetings within defined timelines, ensuring a seamless transition to the assigned Client Experience Manager (CEM).
* Act as a client concierge by connecting clients with the appropriate internal experts (e.g., Practice Directors, Consulting Managers, CEMs, Sales, and other support teams) as needs arise.
* Build strong relationships with executive and operational stakeholders by quickly establishing trust, adapting communication style, and proactively addressing questions or concerns.
* Monitor client sentiment throughout onboarding, de\-escalating issues when needed, and ensuring concerns are resolved or appropriately escalated prior to CEM handoff.
* Gather and validate key onboarding requirements (e.g., credentials, system access, and other transition\-related information) to support continuity of service and successful migrations.
* Track onboarding progress against defined milestones (first touch, meetings, credential completion, CSAT, and transition readiness) and maintain accurate reporting.

 **Job Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in a customer\-facing role such as Customer Success, Client Experience, Account Management, Project Coordination, hospitality, or a similar service\-oriented environment.
* Experience in onboarding, implementation, client transitions, or M\&A integration preferred.
* Demonstrated experience facilitating client or stakeholder meetings.
* Strong interpersonal skills and comfort working across multiple business units.
* Familiarity with CRM systems; Microsoft Dynamics experience preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple client onboarding journeys simultaneously with strong attention to detail.

 **Customer Requirements**


This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

 **Core Competencies**

* **Client Champion** – Relentlessly exceed client expectations. Consistently anticipate needs to deliver valuable solutions and extraordinary outcomes.
* **Problem Solver** – Smart, analytical, inquisitive, knowledge\-seeker that thrives on a challenge.
* **Promise Keeper** – Place high value on keeping our word and doing the right thing. Demonstrate honesty, integrity, and commitment.
* **Collaborative Integrator** –Team player, unifier, relationship\-oriented, win\-win seeker, exemplify the concept of relationships through trust and unity.
* **Driven Intrapreneur** – Exceed goals using independent creative thinking, optimism, self\-confidence, and a can\-do attitude.
* **Inspiring Coach** – Help employees, clients and partners using knowledge, expertise, experience, and situational fluency.

 **Compensation and Benefits**


Base salary range: $75,000 to $90,000\.


This position is also eligible for a bonus in accordance with the terms of the Company's plan.

  

Please note that the quoted pay range for this job is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) experience, including industry or product\-specific experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, and/or other applicable laws.

  

We provide competitive, affordable, and diverse benefit programs that support your total health – from healthy body to healthy mind. These benefits support you and your family in all aspects of life:

* Health and Welfare (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Life and AD\&D Insurance
* Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Transportation and Parking Accounts
* Health Savings Accounts (with company contribution)
* Retirement Planning (401k with matching contribution)
* Legal Benefits
* Identity Theft Protection
* Pet Insurance
* Wellness Program Offerings
* Paid Time Off, accrued per pay period based on years of service starting at 15 days annually.
* 8 Paid Holidays per year, including 1 floating holiday.

  

The compensation and benefits information is accurate of the date of this posting and subject to plan eligibility. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

  

The Company expects to accept applications for this position until September 26, 2026 but encourages interested applicants to apply as soon as possible. We will review this information and one of our Talent Acquisition professionals will reach out if your background aligns to the positions.

 **EOE/Diversity \& Inclusion Statement**


Net at Work is dedicated to unleashing the power and potential of our employees and teams by creating a vibrant and inclusive workplace where each employee can be their best. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity and inclusion. We embrace and encourage equitable treatment of our employees and strive to create a work environment free of discrimination at all organizational levels and in all forms. Net at Work recognizes the rights of all individuals to mutual respect and the acceptance of others without biases based on differences of any kind.

  

Net at Work is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fair hiring practices and to creating a welcoming environment for all team members that is free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Net at Work are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
The Implementation Specialist plays a vital role in bringing new employer groups, health plans, vendors, and benefit programs to life. You'll be the go\-to connector between clients, brokers, stop\-loss carriers, pharmacy benefit managers, network partners, and our internal teams, making sure every benefit plan is set up accurately, on time, and in full compliance every step of the way.

In this role, you'll own implementation and renewal timelines from start to finish \- gathering and validating plan requirements, coordinating system configuration, and supporting eligibility and data file setup. You'll be the steady hand that keeps every operational team prepared and confident for a seamless transition to live administration. We're looking for someone with strong project coordination skills, a sharp eye for detail, solid knowledge of healthcare benefits administration, and a talent for communicating clearly and warmly with stakeholders at every level.

**HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:**

* Coordinate the onboarding and renewal process for employer groups, health plans, vendors, and benefit programs.
* Serve as the primary implementation liaison between clients, brokers, vendors, carriers, internal teams, and technology partners.
* Develop, manage, and monitor implementation and renewal timelines to ensure milestones and deadlines are met.
* Gather, review, and validate plan design requirements, benefit specifications, eligibility rules, vendor requirements, and related documentation.
* Coordinate system configuration activities to ensure benefit plans are set up accurately within applicable administrative platforms.
* Support eligibility file setup, data file testing, vendor feeds, and other operational data requirements.
* Partner with internal departments, including claims, eligibility, customer service, account management, compliance, finance, and IT, to ensure operational readiness.
* Identify implementation risks, issues, and gaps, and work with appropriate parties to resolve them in a timely manner.
* Facilitate meetings, status updates, and communications throughout the implementation or renewal process.
* Maintain accurate records, project documentation, plan materials, and implementation checklists.
* Ensure all required documentation is complete, accurate, and available prior to the effective date or renewal date.
* Support post\-implementation review and issue resolution to ensure a successful transition to ongoing administration.
* Ensure implementation activities are completed in accordance with company policies, client requirements, regulatory standards, and contractual obligations.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU BRING:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous experience in healthcare benefits administration, third\-party administration, health insurance, employee benefits, implementation, account management, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of medical benefits, eligibility, plan design, vendor coordination, and administrative processes.
* Experience coordinating projects, timelines, deliverables, and cross\-functional communication.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
* Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams and external business partners.

**HOW WE SUPPORT YOU:** 

* 5% annual bonus based on company profitability
* Affordable health, vision, and dental insurance for you and your family
* Company contributes up to $2,300 to Health Savings Account annually
* Wellness program that contributes additional money towards your HSA
* Automatic 3% contribution into retirement plan
* Career development and growth opportunities
* Flexible Time Off \& 10 paid holidays per year

If you're looking to contribute your skills to a company that values innovation and positive impact, MotivHealth is the place for you.*

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist, Enterprise Accounts
jobs.description:
Healthcare documentation is broken. Nestmed is fixing it with an AI platform that gives clinicians their time back.


In just one year, we’ve scaled to support tens of thousands of clinicians across more than a million patient visits. We're now the trusted partner for over 60 home health agencies, including 7 of the top 10 enterprises in the US.


Our founding team—hailing from Stanford, YC, Google, and Meta—is backed by the founders of PayPal and Plaid to build the essential infrastructure for the future of the $500B home healthcare industry.


Nestmed's fastest\-growing customers are enterprise multi\-state home health and hospice organizations with hundreds of branches, thousands of clinicians, and tight implementation timelines. We're looking for an **Implementation Specialist** to own these enterprise rollouts end to end: designing the rollout strategy, sequencing branch\-by\-branch go\-lives, and turning time\-strapped clinicians across a sprawling org into confident daily users, at scale.


This isn't just a training role that happens to touch big accounts. It's ownership of the implementation itself: the plan, the phasing, the executive relationship, and the outcome. We’re looking for someone who has done this before and knows how to avoid risks, manage exec level stakeholders, leverage their project management skills, hold strong technical skills and can quickly learn the US home health and hospice landscape.

**What You'll Do**

**Enterprise Rollout Strategy**

* Own the end\-to\-end implementation plan for large, multi\-branch home health and hospice accounts, from kickoff through full adoption across every branch
* Design phased go\-live sequencing (by region, branch tier, or clinical service line) that fits the customer's operational reality, not a generic template
* Build and manage the master implementation timeline, coordinating dependencies across IT, clinical leadership, and branch\-level operations
* Anticipate potential failure points specific to large orgs: competing regional priorities, inconsistent branch\-level readiness, leadership turnover mid\-rollout and build contingency plans before they become escalations

**Training \& Enablement at Scale**

* Lead virtual and on\-site training for clinicians and office staff across dozens to hundreds of branches
* Design and run train\-the\-trainer programs that let branch\-level champions cascade training locally
* Provide targeted 1:1 and small\-group coaching for slower adopter branches
* Travel up to 20% to customer sites for executive check\-ins, regional kickoffs, and high\-stakes go\-lives

**Executive \& Cross\-Functional Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary implementation point of contact for customer executive sponsors (VP/Director of Clinical Operations, Regional Directors) throughout the engagement
* Partner closely with Implementation Leadership on account strategy, executive business reviews, and renewal risk tied to adoption
* Track and report implementation health with rigor
* Proactively identify and escalate at\-risk implementations before they threaten a renewal or expansion

**Adoption \& Change Management**

* Build trust with clinicians and branch leadership by deeply understanding their workflow and how it varies branch to branch within the same organization
* Identify systemic adoption barriers (not just individual stragglers) and design interventions that work across a distributed org
* Monitor usage data across the account and drive targeted follow\-up with low\-engagement branches or regions
* Deliver post\-go\-live reinforcement training and manage the long tail of adoption in a large account, which rarely ends at go\-live

**Clinician \& Customer Advocacy**

* Share frontline and branch\-level insights with Product, Engineering, and CS to influence roadmap and account strategy
* Surface patterns across enterprise accounts, friction that shows up at scale often looks different from friction at a single small agency
* Contribute to case studies and reference\-ability efforts for flagship enterprise accounts

**Who You Are**

**Required**

* 7\+ years in implementation, training, or customer success roles, with direct experience managing complex, multi\-stakeholder rollouts. Enterprise healthcare experience strongly preferred
* Proven track record leading implementations for large, multi\-location organizations (not single\-site deployments)
* Strong program/project management instincts, being comfortable owning a timeline with dozens of moving parts and no one else tracking it for you
* Executive presence: credible and persuasive with Senior Leadership, not just end users
* Exceptional presentation, facilitation, and written communication skills
* Comfortable learning new technology quickly and translating it for non\-technical, clinical audiences
* Empathetic, patient, and energized by helping others learn while also being able to hold a large org accountable to a timeline
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced startup and is comfortable operating with ambiguity in a scaling implementation function
* Willing to travel 20% (U.S.)

**Nice to Have**

* Experience implementing or training clinicians on EMR/EHR or clinical software at scale
* Home health or hospice experience, especially with multi\-branch or multi\-state agencies
* Background in change management, instructional design, or adult learning
* Experience with LMS or training platforms, and with implementation/project tracking tools
* Familiarity with home health and hospice\-specific workflows and regulatory context (OASIS, PDGM, visit compliance)


If you’re passionate about working with high\-impact products that solve real\-world problems, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!


Compensation Range: $115K \- $125K

**Our Newest Opportunity:**

**Summary:**

The Dynamics 365 \& Employee Benefits Systems Training Specialist partners with Product Development teams, Employee Benefits (EB) and Human Resources Consulting (HRC) Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), and business stakeholders to identify learning needs and design training solutions that drive employee proficiency and adoption of Microsoft Dynamics 365\. The role translates system functionality and business processes into practical, engaging learning experiences that enable employees to successfully perform their roles.


This position is the primary learning lead for Dynamics 365 across the Employee Benefits and HRC practices, responsible for programs that support new hires, existing employees, acquired teams, and ongoing system enhancements.


This role also serves as a connector across the Employee Benefits technology ecosystem, helping employees understand how Dynamics 365 integrates with Outreach, ZoomInfo, and other connected technologies that support business workflows.


The ideal candidate combines Employee Benefits business knowledge, technical systems expertise, facilitation excellence, instructional design capability, and strong relationship\-building skills.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

*Design and Develop Training Programs*

* Create and deliver training programs for Microsoft Dynamics 365 and related Employee Benefits technology solutions
* Develop role\-based learning paths aligned to producer, account management, client service, operational, and leadership workflows
* Create instructor\-led training, virtual workshops, eLearning, microlearning, knowledge checks, simulations, and guided practice activities
* Partner with Product Development and SMEs to ensure learning materials accurately reflect current system functionality and business processes

*Understand Learning Needs*

* Conduct learning needs analyses with stakeholders, Product Development teams, and business SMEs
* Identify knowledge gaps, skill gaps, workflow challenges, and adoption barriers
* Adapt training programs to meet the needs of different employee populations and job roles
* Prioritize learning solutions based on business impact and organizational needs

*Learning Design \& Content Development*

* Develop job aids, SOPs, quick reference guides, process maps, eLearning modules, instructional videos, facilitator guides, learner materials, and assessments
* Create video\-based learning using screen capture and editing tools
* Maintain and continuously improve Dynamics 365 learning content and documentation

*Conduct Training Sessions*

* Facilitate engaging virtual and in\-person training programs
* Deliver onboarding training to new hires and employees joining through acquisitions
* Conduct webinars, workshops, office hours, refresher sessions, and individual coaching as needed
* Support major system rollouts, upgrades, and new feature launches with targeted learning initiatives

*Dynamics 365 Adoption \& Enablement*

* Serve as the primary learning resource for Dynamics 365 training and best practices
* Translate technical system updates into practical, business\-focused learning experiences

*Employee Benefits Technology Ecosystem Enablement*

* Maintain a working knowledge of the Employee Benefits technology ecosystem and how systems interact
* Help employees understand the relationships between Dynamics 365 and integrated platforms such as Outreach and ZoomInfo
* Develop training materials that demonstrate end\-to\-end workflows across multiple systems
* Reinforce the importance of data quality and system\-of\-record practices within Dynamics 365

*Product Development Partnership*

* Participate in system enhancement meetings and release planning efforts
* Represent the learning and user adoption perspective during system change discussions

*Know the Business You Serve*

* Build strong partnerships with Employee Benefits and HRC leaders, SMEs, producers, account teams, and operational stakeholders
* Stay current on business priorities, workflows, client lifecycles, and industry trends
* Ensure training clearly connects employee actions within systems to business outcomes and client impact

*Evaluate Training Effectiveness*

* Measure learning effectiveness using participation, completion, knowledge, confidence, application, and feedback metrics
* Conduct after\-action reviews following major training initiatives and technology rollouts
* Use learner and stakeholder feedback to continuously improve training effectiveness

*Support Change Management Efforts*

* Help employees understand what is changing, why it matters, and how it impacts their work
* Develop reinforcement and adoption strategies following training delivery
* Serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders during periods of organizational or technology change

*Manage Training Resources*

* Manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting established deadlines

**Qualifications, Skills and Requirements**

* Experience collaborating with Product Development teams, technology owners, and SMEs to develop learning solutions
* Ability to create and facilitate engaging learning experiences for adult learners
* Strong understanding of instructional design and adult\-learning principles
* Ability to translate complex technical concepts into practical, user\-friendly learning experiences
* Experience delivering technical systems training to diverse audiences
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills
* Expertise in learning content development including video creation and editing
* Experience designing role\-based and workflow\-based technical training programs
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, and OneDrive
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS)
* Excellent organizational, project management, and prioritization skills
* Willingness and ability to travel as needed

**Education, Training and Experience**

*Required*

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 5\+ years of experience in Employee Benefits (required), with additional experience in one or more of: Human Resources Consulting, Insurance or Financial Services, Technical Training, Learning \& Development, Instructional Design, or Systems Training and Enablement
* Advanced user, trainer, administrator, or power\-user experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365
* Experience supporting Dynamics 365 implementations, upgrades, or adoption initiatives
* Experience facilitating instructor\-led and virtual training programs
* Experience developing technical learning content, job aids, and video\-based learning
* Experience partnering with SMEs and business leaders to identify learning needs and develop solutions
* Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously

*Preferred*

* Familiarity with Employee Benefits producer workflows, account management processes, client lifecycles, and reporting
* Familiarity with HRC business processes and systems
* Experience with integrated technologies such as Outreach, ZoomInfo, and related business platforms
* Experience with AI\-forward training tools and approaches
* Knowledge of change management and adoption methodologies
* Experience supporting onboarding and acquisition integration efforts

The typical base pay range for this role nationwide is $70,000 to $85,000 per year .
